title: First evidence edition published
summary: The Clean Air site, report and decision brief for India, generated from the research registers (cutoff 22 November 2026).

title: Regional expansion
summary: Country dossiers for South and Southeast Asia, the funding atlas, decision pathways and layered reading added within the same cutoff.

title: Organisations atlas
summary: 95 organisation profiles, 28 activity records, 41 documented funding links, stories, gaps and a comparison tool.

title: Corrections register, passage-level verification and agent access
summary: Corrections listed with old and new text; every claim shows a passage-level verification state; Markdown copies of every page, llms.txt, evidence packs and a data catalogue added. Four claims reworded for the site's editorial voice without changing meaning.

title: Passage review of 77 claims
summary: Supporting passages located for 201 of 222 claims (59 by documented manual review). 18 claims remain awaiting review with a note on what is missing; 3 sources could not be read automatically.

title: The web of dirty air
summary: An interactive systems map: 40 parts, 52 connections each rated for evidence, 6 feedback loops shown as interpretations, 25 levers with who could act and who has funded related work, 5 guided journeys, a full text alternative and data downloads.

title: A Breath of Change integrated
summary: The World Bank's 2025 solutions book integrated across the site: 41 new claims with page locators, where our air comes from, the 4Is, who pays to make clean air last, one airshed many governments, a job and 4Is label on every intervention, new systems-map links and a protection journey.

title: Latest signals section added
summary: A scheduled discovery feed of new research, reports, policy, news and funding announcements on air pollution in South and Southeast Asia, refreshed twice a day from tested sources. Signals are third-party source records, not reviewed evidence: they carry no evidence rating and do not change the 22 November 2026 research edition.
